create_local_cost_function: create a Local cost function with a LieGroup variable, target, and cost weight
compute_local_error: compute the error tensor by calling error on a Local cost function instance
compute_local_jacobians: compute jacobians for a Local cost function using fast approximation or exact mode
get_local_cost_dim: get the dimension of a Local cost function by calling its dim method
copy_local_cost_function: copy a Local cost function instance with an optional new name using _copy_impl
